title: One-command setup that works on Linux and Intel Macs; fix the dead README steps
description:
`README.md:43` tells contributors to run `node spikes/web-audio/serve.mjs`, but `spikes/` does not exist. `.cargo/config.toml` hardcodes `.tools/wasi-sdk-34.0-arm64-macos` for `WASI_SDK_PATH`, `CC/CXX/AR_wasm32_wasip1`, while `scripts/fetch-tools.sh:5-8` downloads a platform-specific directory, so the README wasm steps fail on Linux and Intel Macs; `scripts/amplify-wasm.sh:32-38` overrides the variables by hand as a workaround. Getting a first sound means: submodule init, fetch-tools, a wasm build, a Python venv with the basic-pitch `--no-deps` step, `scripts/fetch-samples.py`, the Python server, `npm install` and `npm run dev`. There is no Makefile, justfile or setup script. `README.md:31` mentions a machine-specific Homebrew cargo, `.claude/launch.json` hardcodes `analysis/.venv/bin/python`, and `AGENTS.md` refers to `~/Projects/Virtuus`, a machine-local path.

Done when: `fetch-tools.sh` writes a platform-correct `.cargo/config.toml` (or `build.rs` resolves the wasi-sdk from the fetched directory); a `justfile` or `scripts/setup.sh` performs every step above; the README build section is verified on a clean Linux container; the dead `spikes/` line and the machine-local paths are gone.
